responsibility: This definition module declares simple ASCII-oriented case-conversion utilities for character arrays and individual characters. It belongs to the gm2 string helper layer and exports procedures to copy a string into uppercase or lowercase form plus Cap and Lower for single-character conversion, providing a lightweight text-normalization interface above raw CHAR values.
same_name_distinction: Declaration half of the StrCase pair: it publishes the uppercase/lowercase string and character conversion procedures, while the sibling implementation file contains the ASCII conversion logic and buffer-copy behavior.
